simple.summary: רְוָחָה (rᵉvâchâh) means relief First listed occurrence: Exod 8 11.

definitions.full: H7309. revachah רְוָחָה noun feminine respite, relief ; — absolute ׳ר Exod 8:11 (J); suffix רַוְחָתִי Lam 3:56 (Ew Löhr Bu Comm. צַוְחָתִי my outcry ; then strike out שַׁוְעָתִי as gloss); read לָֽרְוָחָה also for לָֽרְוָיָה ᵑ0 Psa 66:12 (see below רוה ). רְוָיָה see רוה
